entries.question: Who is Nandini?
entries.answer: B. Nandini is the Head of Engineering at HireHappi (Emmess Technologies Pvt Ltd), based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. She is an AI Full Stack Developer and product builder who ships production-grade AI applications — LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and agentic workflows on top of a modern full stack. She moved from a commerce background to a BCA at St. Francis College, joined HireHappi as an intern in Mar 2025, and became Head of Engineering within 16 months.

entries.question: What products has she built?
entries.answer: Three production products: LegalMaiA — a complete AI operating system for law firms covering the full case lifecycle; ChooseYourCollege.com — a live, revenue-generating AI college discovery platform built on NIRF data and semantic search; and ResumeTailor — an AI resume optimization platform that tailors resumes to specific job descriptions.

entries.answer: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C++ and C. Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 and TailwindCSS. Backend: Node.js and REST APIs. Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and vector databases. AI: RAG, LLM integration, prompt engineering, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Automation: n8n. DevOps: Git, GitHub and CI/CD. Day-to-day tooling: Cursor, Claude Code, Kiro, Antigravity and VS Code.

entries.question: What experience does she have?
entries.answer: 16 months at HireHappi (Emmess Technologies Pvt Ltd), with two promotions in that window. entries.question: What is LegalMaiA?
entries.answer: LegalMaiA is a complete AI operating system for law firms — not just a drafting tool. It manages the entire lifecycle of a legal case through modules for case management, petition generation, AI drafting, hearings, timelines, a document repository, firm management, a citation engine, court records, eCourts integration, analytics and role-based access. It is built on Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and a vector DB, with RAG over OpenAI, Gemini and Claude, n8n automation and AWS infrastructure.

entries.question: What is ChooseYourCollege?
entries.answer: ChooseYourCollege.com is a live, revenue-generating AI search platform that helps students find the right college. It combines NIRF ranking data, advanced filtering and semantic vector search so students can describe what they want in plain language and get results that match intent, not keywords. It also ships an interactive analytics dashboard. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, OpenAI and vector search.

entries.question: What is ResumeTailor?
entries.answer: ResumeTailor is an AI-powered resume optimization platform. It parses an existing resume, analyses a target job description, and rewrites the content to match the role — while keeping the output ATS-parseable and human-sounding. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, Supabase and RAG.

entries.question: How does she approach AI architecture?
entries.answer: RAG-first. Chunking strategy, embeddings and vector search do most of the work grounding model output, with the LLM as the reasoning layer rather than the source of truth. On top of that: structured and evaluated prompts, agentic workflows via n8n, model fallbacks across OpenAI, Gemini and Claude, and cost control at the integration layer.

entries.question: What automation work has she done?
entries.answer: Two production automation pipelines. First, an AI content creation pipeline covering topic generation, scripting, storyboarding, visual generation, editing, approval and publishing — built with n8n, LLMs, Playwright, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Google Drive and WhatsApp, using status-driven workflows with human approval checkpoints. Second, a lead pipeline connecting Meta Ads, WhatsApp CTAs, WhatsApp conversations and Zoho CRM, automating lead creation, qualification, CRM updates and follow-up.
